summary: Iteration 151: Tested Employer Team Attendance features on My Team page. All backend APIs (team/today, team/report/monthly, employer/my-team) working correctly. Frontend shows Today's Attendance snapshot, Monthly Attendance Summary table, and per-member attendance in detail dialog. Security tests passed - non-employer roles correctly denied access.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement needed

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ GET /api/attendance/team/today returns today's attendance for employer's team (13 members including employer)
✅ Response includes: date, total_team, present, absent, late, on_leave, wfh, not_checked_in, members array, is_holiday
✅ Each member in response has: user_id, name, email, status, check_in, check_out, hours_worked, is_late
✅ GET /api/attendance/team/report/monthly returns monthly summary with summaries array
✅ Each summary has: user_id, name, email, present, absent, half_days, leaves, wfh, late_count, total_hours
✅ GET /api/employer/my-team returns team performance data with 12 members
✅ Response includes: team info, members array with mandates/pipeline/revenue, summary stats
✅ Security: Admin correctly denied access to /api/attendance/team/today (403)
✅ Security: Recruiter correctly denied access to /api/attendance/team/today (403)
✅ Security: Admin correctly denied access to /api/attendance/team/report/monthly (403)
✅ Security: Recruiter correctly denied access to /api/attendance/team/report/monthly (403)
✅ Frontend: My Team page (/employer/my-team) loads with data-testid='employer-my-team'
✅ Frontend: Performance summary cards show Team Members, Active Mandates, Pipeline, Revenue
✅ Frontend: Today's Attendance section (data-testid='today-attendance-snapshot') shows stats and per-member pills
✅ Frontend: Monthly Attendance Summary table (data-testid='monthly-attendance-summary') shows per-member stats
✅ Frontend: Team Members list shows 12 members with today's attendance status badges
✅ Frontend: Clicking team member opens dialog with Attendance tab showing today's status and monthly summary
context_for_next_testing_agent: Employer Team Attendance features fully tested. The employer maneet@vhc.in has 'Delhi Team' with 12 recruiters. The /api/attendance/team/today endpoint returns 13 members (12 recruiters + employer). My Team page at /employer/my-team shows: (1) Performance summary cards, (2) Today's Attendance snapshot with stats and per-member status pills, (3) Monthly Attendance Summary table, (4) Team Members list with attendance badges. Clicking a member opens dialog with Attendance tab showing today's status and monthly breakdown. All security tests passed - admin and recruiter roles correctly denied access to employer-only endpoints.
